descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94745 AC 7; TFA-94704 AC 4 · “No patient data cached on the device beyond the minimal session cache”. Mixed: stated part — no patient data on the device beyond a minimal session cache; our part — IndexedDB, localStorage and Cache Storage empty after sign-out / sign-out everywhere (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B02 · S0 · new

Unsaved dictation audio and transcripts stay in the browser's storage after sign-out and after account deletion; a second physician signing in on the same browser gets no prompt, but the data is on the device (Quinn 2026-10-20: background clean-up, not shown to the next user; no rejection — comment on TFA-94745, fix PR #117)

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa; TFA-92570 AC 7 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Was a decision item; reclassified as a bug (PHI exposure). Daniela to confirm what sign-out must clear Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92570/94745): the second physician sees no Recover prompt (that cell passed); sign-out and account deletion both call only clearAllDrafts (SettingsModal.tsx:111, :138), which leaves the recording store. After a successful save the whole text also stays in the draft store until sign-out (TC-10/S29 c). Whether P0 still fits is a question for Quinn. 2026-10-20: Quinn confirmed on dev the recording cache stays after an account switch but the app never shows it; treated as a small background fix, not a rejection. Fix PR round-companion#117 (main ticket TFA-94745).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-23/S25, OAT-03/S24, EFS/S20

Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S16 Device storage after sign-out: no patient text or audio left in IndexedDB, localStorage or Cache Storage

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 The device keeps only the unsaved tail of a dictation or typed text, until the server has it, and wipes it on sign-out (this device and 'Sign out everywhere') and on account deletion. (TFA-94745 AC 7; TFA-94745 comment 2026-10-05)
  • T3 No patient data is cached on the device beyond the minimal session cache (per SOW). (TFA-94704 AC 4; TFA-94704 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Local stack in desktop Chrome with DevTools → Application open and a microphone, signed in as a fresh @roundai.test physician with the fixture Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident. A person runs it.

When (1) Type a line into the Hospital Encounter notes box and wait for autosave. (2) Start dictation on the Hospital Pre-Round and on the Nursing Home Pre-Round, and set DevTools offline before each transcript lands, so the recording stays in 'round-ai-local-audio'. …

Then After Sign out and after Sign out everywhere, none of the four stores holds patient text (the typed line, the dictated words, the patient's name) or audio. What is kept while signed in and after the revoke is recorded store by store.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): T4 (TFA-94745 AC 7 and its 2026-10-05 comment: wiped on sign-out) and T3 (TFA-94704 AC 4). Any patient text or audio in any of the four stores after Sign out or Sign out everywhere = Fail, quoted with store and key; per mode (3.3). …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
